This writ petition is filed challenging the impugned order dated 03.12.2025 passed for the assessment year 2019-2020.

document_contents.quote: pointing out to the aforementioned difference in GSTR-3B, GSTR-1 and form 26AS and directing the petitioner to show cause as to why appropriate penalty and interest be levied.
It is his contention that the case can never come under Section 74 of the Act, as there is no willful suppression or an intention to evade the tax that is alleged.

defects_argued.quote: Therefore, in this case, I am unable to hold that it can be a case under Section 74 of the Act.

outcome.quote: In view thereof this writ petition is allowed on the following terms: The impugned order dated03.12.2025 shall stand set aside.
